# Pay app guides: schedule of values calculator and pay application guides

> Free, private schedule of values / continuation sheet calculator for construction subcontractors (work completed, stored materials, retainage held and released, balance to finish, current payment due), plus plain-English guides on filling out a pay application, retainage with cited public retainage caps for 16 US states, conditional vs unconditional lien waivers, and change orders, plus a change order log. Runs in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free to use and source available (FSL-1.1-MIT). Not legal, tax, accounting or financial advice. Not affiliated with the American Institute of Architects and does not reproduce the AIA G702/G703 forms. Statutes were read on 2026-11-24; check the linked statute before relying on it. Hosted pay-app billing for subcontractors is in development, with early access; nothing is for sale yet.

## Pages

- [Schedule of values calculator](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/): continuation-sheet arithmetic, over-billing check, summary, CSV.
- [How to fill out a pay application](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/how-to-fill-out-a-pay-application.html): every column and summary line with a worked example.
- [Retainage explained](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/retainage-explained.html): calculation, reduction, release, flow-down, and public retainage caps for CA, TX, FL, NY, PA, IL, NC, MI, VA, WA, MA, AZ, MN, NV, OR, UT with official statute links.
- [Conditional vs unconditional lien waivers](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/conditional-vs-unconditional-lien-waivers.html): the four waiver types, when to sign each, California and Florida statutory forms.
- [Free schedule of values template (Excel)](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/schedule-of-values-template.html): a blank .xlsx continuation sheet and summary with the formulas in (total completed and stored, percent, balance to finish, per-line retainage, payment due, an over-billing check), plus a filled-in example. No macros or external links; opens in Excel, Google Sheets and LibreOffice.
- [Statutory lien waiver forms by state](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/lien-waiver-forms-by-state.html): which states set the waiver wording by statute (Arizona, Nevada, Texas, Utah, Florida, Michigan, Wyoming read on the official sites on 2026-11-25; California linked), how many forms, how strictly each must be followed, and the traps in each.
- [Change order log](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/change-order-log.html): paste a change order log; revised contract sum, pending money and how long it has waited, billing on unsigned or rejected changes flagged, approved change orders written as schedule-of-values lines for the pay application generator, and exceptions wording for a progress lien waiver.
- [Change orders and the schedule of values](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/change-orders-schedule-of-values.html): approved and deductive change orders on the SOV and summary.
- [Retainage in QuickBooks Online](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/retainage-in-quickbooks.html): QuickBooks has no retainage field; the Retainage Receivable account and item, the negative invoice line, the release invoice, finding unbilled retainage outside A/R aging, the cash-basis caveat, and an invoice-line calculator. Sources are Intuit help and community pages.
- [Prompt payment laws for subcontractors](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/prompt-payment-laws.html): how many days a GC has to pass the owner's payment down to a sub, and late-payment interest, in Texas, California, Illinois, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Virginia (public work) and Florida, each linked to the statute (read 2026-11-25; rates given only where the text read confirmed them), plus a late-payment interest calculator.
- [Pay application software for subcontractors, compared](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/pay-application-software-compared.html): spreadsheet, QuickBooks Online, Knowify, PayAppHub, Trimble Pay and Siteline with their published prices (read 2026-11-25, aggregator prices marked), what GC portals charge the sub (Textura 0.22% capped at $5,000; Procore Pay 0.2% capped at $4,000 per commitment unless the GC pays; Trimble Pay free when invited), and a portal fee calculator.
- [How to get your retainage released](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/retainage-release.html): what GCs and owners usually ask for before releasing retainage (punch list, final pay app, final conditional waiver, lower-tier waivers, consent of surety, closeout documents), how the release date is set by the subcontract or a statute, and a release date calculator that writes a dated request letter listing any closeout items still open.
- [Pay application checker](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/pay-application-checker.html): why pay applications get sent back, and a checker that compares this month's draft with last month's approved application line by line: wrong "from previous applications", a scheduled value changed without a change order, a missing line, a new line not numbered as a change order, stored materials that disappeared, a retainage rate change, and previous certificates that are not last month's earned less retainage. Paste CSV or spreadsheet cells; nothing is uploaded.
- [Overbilling and underbilling](https://marisstella.app/pay-app-guides/overbilling-underbilling.html): why the percent complete on a pay application and on a cost-to-cost WIP schedule disagree (front-loaded SOV, stored materials, unapproved change orders, cost overruns), what banks and sureties read into each, the adjusting journal entry, and a one-job calculator: earned revenue, over or under billing, gross profit to date, cash against cost, and what to bill next period to finish even.
